newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 3.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 3.

text.p: These are the main headlines of ther news reported by Radio Latvia at noon on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- The economic crimes division of the police has discovered an illegal printing facility counterfeiting Russian excise tax labels for alcohol and tobacco in Riga.
- China says it is satisfied with mutual relations with Latvia following a row over Taiwan five years ago.

- Latvia's munucipality representatives participate in a European congress in Strasbourg. Local municipalities in Latvia claim that their financial resources are being cut and that the central government is imposing a process of centralisation.
